taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 127 | 0.822 | 0.822
2 | 50.4 | 5.63 | 6.45
3 | 126 | 21.2 | 27.7
4 | 149 | 29.7 | 57.3
5 | 197 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 27.7 – 57.3 m
Recommendation: Drill to a total depth of at least 60 m to fully penetrate the main aquifer zone and provide adequate sump. Install well screens across the high-yielding sand interval (28 – 57 m) with proper gravel packing to optimize yield and prevent sand ingress.
